principles: One short family check-in can complete the important activities.
Participation is celebrated and never required.
Pictures and faces work without reading or understanding projections.
Yahoo remains the official source for scores and matchup results.
The commissioner confirms results before awards and memories become final.

stages.label: Tuesday Trophy Time
stages.headline: Celebrate last week
stages.description: Reveal final results, the weekly high score, prediction results, achievements, and one favorite family moment.

stages.label: Pick the Winners
stages.headline: Choose who will win
stages.description: Tap a manager picture for each family matchup, then choose a happy, unsure, or super-confident face.
locks: Each matchup locks when its NFL games begin; other matchups stay open.

stages.label: Game of the Week
stages.headline: The family spotlight
stages.description: Feature one matchup, rivalry story, and a simple question the whole family can answer.

stages.label: Weekend Fun
stages.headline: Pick an MVP or try a challenge
stages.description: Choose a favorite player by picture, try an optional family challenge, or send a friendly prewritten reaction.
locks: MVP choices close before Tuesday recap.

stages.label: Make It Official
stages.headline: Confirm the week
stages.description: The commissioner enters or confirms Yahoo results, picks the family-memory awards, and publishes the recap.
locks: Published results are editable by the commissioner without deleting their history.
